title: Live view and takeover
summary: Ask the person to take over a browser, the sandbox computer or the desktop for a step only they should do.

principles: Use request_takeover for steps only the person should do: signing in, passwords and one-time codes, CAPTCHAs, payments, or anything you are unsure they want done.
While waiting, do nothing on that hand. When control comes back, take a snapshot before acting: the page may have changed.

tools.name: request_takeover
tools.title: Ask the person to take over
tools.description: Ask the person to take control of a hand (chrome, managed, sandbox or desktop) for a step only they should do, and wait until they give it back. Returns when they are done or decline.

reason.description: What the person should do, in one sentence.
